title: Filter works well. Actual use is cumbersome
text:
Filter works well. Actual use is cumbersome. This is not as good as I expected. It filters the water and definitely does what it says. It's the day to day functionality that irritates me. It looks like a sizeable pitcher, close to a gallon, but it only holds half the water. The quantity is reduced be the length of the filter - mine will not process water after it reaches the bottom of the filter. This means I have to do the whole process twice to get an actual pitcher of purified water.

The other thing is the pour spout and lid. It flops open and can even fall out as you pour. If you hold it down and pour, that's fine, but it's a multi finger operation. There's no reason this lid can't have a little catch of some sort to prevent spilling.
